The Waves Of Kilkee

Composed by Joanie Madden and Brian Keane.

Transcribed after dictation assignment from Alice Farren (Musescore)

↳ Posted by Joaquin Juno on February 24th, 2022.

Re: The Waves Of Kilkee

This is a really lovely waltz and I can see why it appears in the recent discussion here about inspirational music. It’d take a while to memorize as it’s so long!!

↳ Posted by suskin on March 16th, 2022.

Re: The Waves Of Kilkee

There’s a section of eight bars that repeats (and could itself be written as the same melody with two endings), and then reprises once more, so it’s really only about half as long in terms of material to memorize as it looks written out in this version.

Re: The Waves Of Kilkee

This tune, like several of Joanie’s compositions, are real “tear-jerkers” to me. The arrangement of Cherish the Ladies and her whistle solo is heartbreaking. She’s an emotive whistler, for sure. More than just fast, ornate playing… she knows how to add the vibrato and subtleties so it sounds like someone SINGING.
